scripts.dev: npm run build -w @checkout/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @checkout/api" "npm run dev -w @checkout/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @checkout/contracts && npm run build -w @checkout/api && npm run build -w @checkout/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -k "npm run start -w @checkout/api" "npm run start -w @checkout/web"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @checkout/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run docs:check
scripts.docker-build: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
